verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Godot's generic asset import pipeline (auto-import, import plugins, drag-and-drop, batch import parameters) but never mentions glTF, FBX, or USD specifically, nor any evidence about import fidelity/cleanliness for these interchange formats. Missing for 10: any documentation or community evidence of glTF/FBX/USD import support, fidelity, or known issues.
